mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_notification_setting (username, system_enabled, activity_enabled, task_enabled) VALUES (#{username}, 1, 1, 0)

INSERT INTO user_notification_setting (username, system_enabled, activity_enabled, task_enabled) VALUES (#{username}, #{systemEnabled}, #{activityEnabled}, #{taskEnabled}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE system_enabled = VALUES(system_enabled), activity_enabled = VALUES(activity_enabled), task_enabled = VALUES(task_enabled)
mapper.select: SELECT version_name, latest, release_note FROM app_version ORDER BY latest DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_membership (username, plan_name, status, benefits) VALUES (#{username}, '普通会员', 'ACTIVE', '基础工具可用')
mapper.select:
SELECT id, category, title, description, icon_tone, occurred_at FROM user_history
ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT owner_username, owner_display_name, COUNT(*) slot_count, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(trip_date), '%Y-%m-%d') next_date, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(start_time), '%H:%i:%s') next_time FROM user_trip_slot WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND owner_username != #{username} AND trip_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY owner_username, owner_display_name ORDER BY next_date ASC, next_time ASC, owner_username ASC

SELECT id, owner_username, owner_display_name, title, place, trip_date, start_time, end_time, status, applicant_username, applicant_display_name, apply_note, applied_at, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM user_trip_slot WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND owner_username = #{ownerUsername} AND owner_username != #{username} AND trip_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 6 DAY) ORDER BY trip_date ASC, start_time ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, owner_username, owner_display_name, title, place, trip_date, start_time, end_time, status, applicant_username, applicant_display_name, apply_note, applied_at, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM user_trip_slot WHERE owner_username = #{username} ORDER BY trip_date ASC, start_time ASC, id DESC

SELECT id, owner_username, owner_display_name, title, place, trip_date, start_time, end_time, status, applicant_username, applicant_display_name, apply_note, applied_at, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM user_trip_slot WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_trip_slot (owner_username, owner_display_name, title, place, trip_date, start_time, end_time, status) VALUES (#{ownerUsername}, #{ownerDisplayName}, #{title}, #{place}, #{tripDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, 'OPEN')
mapper.update: UPDATE user_trip_slot SET status = 'PENDING', applicant_username = #{applicantUsername}, applicant_display_name = #{applicantDisplayName}, apply_note = #{applyNote}, applied_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, reviewed_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN' AND owner_username != #{applicantUsername}

UPDATE user_trip_slot SET status = 'OPEN', applicant_username = NULL, applicant_display_name = NULL, apply_note = NULL, applied_at = NULL, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_username = #{ownerUsername} AND status = 'PENDING'
